name: Khumi Chin

ancestors.notes: Descent per Glottolog classification of Khumi Chin (khum1248).

notes: Skeleton. Khumi Chin is a Kuki-Chin (Sino-Tibetan) language of the Chin Hills and Bangladesh, written in a Latin-based orthography. Base Latin consonants and vowels plus digraphs ch/sh/ng/ny, aspirates kh/ph/th and the voiceless lateral hl are mapped. Lexical tone is not recovered by the romanization and is left unencoded, so an elevated PER floor is expected. Khumi Chin tone is not orthographically recoverable in the practical spelling and is left unencoded; stress is not lexically contrastive (documented exemption).
